name: Eguchi Yayoi
source:
Eguchi Family's Eldest Daughter. Director of Harmonica Nursery School. After her husband, the previous director, passed away, she became the director of Harmonica Nursery School.

A cheerful big sister who looks great in her apron and never lets her smile fade, no matter how tough things get. She's also a playful and adorable older sister.

"Don't worry about the debt, I'll take care of it ☆ More importantly, Yuu-chan, if anything's bothering you, don't hesitate to tell your big sister."

Yayoi-nee  is a widow who's surprisingly skilled at playing the shakuhachi! Having become a mother figure to the protagonist, she naturally knows exactly what feels good to him.

Her specialty is a motherly love-filled blowjob! She wraps her tongue around his entire shaft, sucking him smoothly and deeply.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916184540/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/feralym/chara.html] archived official site[/url]]
